native_lightning_base.recommendation: Lightweight ground-only subset. Avoid full kineticfield wall around a tower. Infinite ambient needs adapted source or managed refresh; do not assume an arbitrary CP2 duration changes all child behavior.

cp.3: written by SetControlPointsToParticle; do not manually move it

angular_meteor.timing: ConstrainDistanceToPath has fixed travel time 1.5 seconds. CP2 only changes stop time. Adapt the visual asset to current skill timing; never delay authoritative damage to match this cosmetic.
angular_meteor.cleanup: DestroyParticle(false) at actual hit to start endcaps then ReleaseParticleIndex; guard against stale target/tower and duplicate cleanup.
angular_meteor.evidence: RERL explicitly names Rubick Arcana cube model, not Slark; package path and model confirmed locally.

native_dark_center.evidence: Native RERL and DATA confirm texture and MOD2X. Decoded texture has soft black center and zero-alpha border. Adapted to one WORLD_Z_ALIGNED particle at CP1.x * 0.65; no full Black Hole spell or gameplay effect is spawned.
native_dark_center.soft_boundary_adaptation: Decoded RGB is all white and ring shape is in alpha; our gentle ground boundary uses alpha blend at 0.20 times profile alpha.

weapon_visual_constraints: Use authoritative WEAPON_EQUIPPED_CHANGED main_hand slot and HERO_SUMMONED unit identity; never infer main hand from engine slot index.
Keep ambient effects bounded to at most three layers per hero and apply cooldown to hit accents.
Native item armlet requires hands hitbox set; do not use it as a universal weapon attachment without checking hero model.
Native radiance_owner uses 550 emissions/sec and 512 max particles; unsuitable as a light first weapon glow.
No damage, attack speed, stats, or projectile flight timing changes belong in the visual service.
